chunks: Isma'il ibn Muslim narrated from Abī ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام, who said:
The Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله forbade that milk be mixed with water for sale.

key_terms.رَسُولُ اللَّهِ: the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله
key_terms.رَوَى: narrated; indicates transmission of the hadith
key_terms.لِلْبَيْعِ: for sale; in the context of commercial transaction

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible to mix milk with water and sell it?
ai.summary: This hadith conveys a legal prohibition against mixing milk with water when selling it. It reflects the Islamic requirement of honesty and fairness in trade and attributes this ruling to the sunnah of the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله.
